purpose: Screening charts from existing runs; no new model runs or calibration.

comparisons.label: Golf petrol · WLTP [1]
comparisons.source_conditions: Minimum published mass 1307 kg; WLTP test mass and measured road-load coefficients unavailable. Adjusted run uses 1307 kg as curb mass plus 75 kg driver; this is an assumption, not exact homologation mass. Default model road loads, auxiliaries and fuel blend retained.
comparisons.comparability: WLTC/WLTP cycle family; generic car versus a specific homologated product

comparisons.label: Golf diesel · WLTP [1]
comparisons.source_conditions: Minimum published mass 1387 kg; adjusted run assumes this is curb mass and adds 75 kg driver, with 85 kW power. Exact homologation mass, coast-down coefficients, cold-start and vehicle control are not matched.
comparisons.comparability: WLTC/WLTP cycle family; generic car versus a specific homologated product

comparisons.label: Corolla hybrid · WLTP [2]
comparisons.source_conditions: Published curb mass 1345-1410 kg; adjusted run takes midpoint 1377.5 kg plus 75 kg driver, 103 kW system power. Default electric/combustion shares, road loads and efficiency maps retained.
comparisons.comparability: WLTC/WLTP cycle family; generic HEV does not reproduce Toyota hybrid control

comparisons.label: Diesel bus · SORT 2 [3]
comparisons.source_conditions: Published curb mass 10600 kg; nominal SORT load 3200 kg has vehicle-dependent corrections not fully specified. Adjusted run assumes 13800 kg total, 209 kW, 20 C, HVAC off. Actual HVAC state unspecified. Shipped trace is 938 m versus nominal 920 m; it is not the measured speed trace.
comparisons.comparability: Historical 2017 measurement; approximate SORT2 cycle; 13 m model class versus 12 m bus

comparisons.label: Diesel trucks · road test [4]
comparisons.source_conditions: 342.8 km route, 31 t test combination mass, 79.79-80.18 km/h; fuel excludes AdBlue. Adjusted model uses payload to match 31000 kg within 1 kg, keeping default power, road load and efficiencies. Model route is about 108 km at about 67 km/h including stored zeros.
comparisons.comparability: Cross-route context only; VECTO-derived Long haul is not the published road-test route

comparisons.label: 2017 bus · SORT 2 · onboard [3]
comparisons.source_conditions: Electrical consumption measured onboard with WT1800E, not at AC plug. Compare model TtW/36, not electricity consumption*100. Exact test load and battery configuration unclear. No-HVAC case is a sensitivity assumption, not the documented test state.
comparisons.comparability: Historical measurement; approximate SORT2 cycle; mass, auxiliaries and battery boundary not fully matched

comparisons.label: Golf petrol · Ecotest [5]
comparisons.source_boundary: Petrol consumption; protocol uses exhaust carbon balance
comparisons.comparability: Measured fuel comparator supplementing the original WLTP specification

comparisons.source_boundary: Petrol consumption; protocol uses exhaust carbon balance
comparisons.source_conditions: Estate body. Different variant from the original audit's MY2025 hatchback reference.
comparisons.comparability: Phase-specific hybrid-control diagnostic after matching the estate variant
